caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular stone tablet with a rounded top. The surface of the tablet is carved with decorative details. At the top center, within the rounded arch, there is a sunburst or floral-like pattern. Below this, the tablet is divided into three arched sections. The left section has a heart with rays around it, with a symbol resembling a "P" to its left. The center section contains the number "7" and the right section contains the number "3" with a bird or dove facing right above it. Together, the numbers read "1673". Below the arches, there is a horizontal inscription that reads “COLEBROOKDALE FURNACE.” In the lower section of the tablet, there is a diamond shape made up of smaller diamond patterns. The entire drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray, and positioned on a lightly stained, beige background with a drawn rectangular border surrounding the artwork, and visible tape marks around the corners of the border.
title: Pa. German Fire Back
